feeds.title: My Food Story » Vegetarian
feeds.description: Richa is the cook, writer, and photographer behind this blog. She celebrates vegetarian food with her collection of over 200 vegetarian recipes. Crowd favorites include the best palak paneer, Mumbai-style pav bhaji with homemade pav, baingan bharta to the best khichdi, and dal makhani out there!

feeds.title: Vidhya's Home Cooking Blog
feeds.description: A vegetarian food blog with unique and interesting recipes from all over the world mainly focused on South Indian Cuisine. From traditional, authentic recipes to fusion and eggless bakes, you can find it all in Vidhya's vegetarian kitchen.

feeds.title: Dassana's Veg Recipes
feeds.description: Vegrecipesofindia.com is a food blog by Dassana Amit, a vegetarian chef who has been sharing tried and tested vegetarian recipes since 2009. The blog has over 2,000 recipes, including Indian, international, and baking recipes. Some of the most popular recipes on the blog include Samosa Recipe, Dal Tadka, Idli Recipe, Pav Bhaji Recipe, and Chilli Paneer Recipe.

feeds.title: Indian Veggie Delight
feeds.description: Bhavana Patil's Indian Veggie Delight is a website that provides recipes for Indian vegetarian dishes. It has a wide variety of recipes, including appetizers, main courses, desserts, and drinks. The recipes are easy to follow and use simple ingredients. The website also has a blog section with articles on Indian cuisine and vegetarian cooking.

feeds.title: Tomato Blues
feeds.description: Anusha's Tomato Blues is a happy space where she shares easy vegetarian and vegan recipes. At Tomato Blues, the mission is to make vegetarian and plant-based food fun and easy for all. Whether you are looking for some vegan Indian recipes or gluten-free recipes, there is a recipe for everyone!

feeds.title: The Curry Guy » Indian Vegetarian
feeds.description: Great Curry Recipes is a website created by Dan Toombs, also known as The Curry Guy. The website features over 1000 curry recipes from around the world, including Indian, Thai, Malaysian, and Sri Lankan curries. On this page, you will find links to some of the most popular Indian vegetarian recipes around. Most are quick and easy to prepare and taste amazing.

feeds.title: Hebbars Kitchen
feeds.description: The blog was founded by Archana Hebbar, a home cook and food blogger from Bangalore, India. Hebbars Kitchen features a wide variety of vegetarian Indian recipes, including breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, sweets, and desserts. The recipes are all easy to follow and use simple ingredients that are readily available.

feeds.title: Cooking Carnival
feeds.description: Dhwani Mehta is the founder of Cooking Carnival. Here you can browse the best the world has to offer in vegetarian cuisine. Find vegan recipes from dozens of countries that are as delicious as they are easy-to-make. Healthy food has never tasted so good!

feeds.title: Jeyashri's Kitchen
feeds.description: Jeyashri's Kitchen is vegetarian food blog with over 1000 plus recipes with detailed step wise instructions. This website has a good collection of South Indian, North Indian and international recipes and also includes Eggless baking recipes too.

feeds.title: Kripa's Food Diary Blog
feeds.description: Shrikripa is a fashion designer by profession with a passion for cooking. Here, you will see lots of traditional Mangalore recipes and trials as well as Shrikripa's own recipes.

feeds.title: Madappalli Temple's Kitchen
feeds.description: The blog Sadhana Kitchen is a vegetarian and mostly vegan food blog with a focus on onion and garlic-free recipes. It was created by Madappalli, a self-described 'temple cook' who shares recipes from her travels and her own kitchen. The blog has been around since 2009 and has over 1,000 recipes, including dishes from India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and the West.

feeds.title: Sukhi's Blog » Vegetarian Indian Food
feeds.description: Born in India and inspired by her grandmother, Sukhi Singh had a natural gift for cooking. In 1985 she moved to the U.S. with a passion and vision for sharing her native cuisine with those who love good food. The website Sukhis.com has a category of Indian recipes for vegetarians, which includes over 100 recipes. The recipes are organized by course, such as appetizers, main courses, and desserts.

feeds.title: Kamala's Corner
feeds.description: Kamala's Corner is a website that features South Indian vegetarian recipes, kolams, and rangolis. The recipes are categorized into breakfast, chutney, festival, fruits, gravies, juices, kootu, kuzhambu, masala powders, and more. The website also has a blog section where Kamala shares her thoughts on food, culture, and life.

feeds.title: Share the Spice
feeds.description: Browse simple and well-balanced vegetarian and vegan recipes that celebrate the vibrant spices and textures of Indian cuisine. Shweta, the blogger, recipe developer, and photographer behind this blog writes to teach you how to incorporate nourishing vegetarian and vegan meals that are fun and full of flavor!

feeds.title: Manjula's Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: Learn to cook Indian Vegetarian Recipes the easy way. Manjula is here to teach you simple and practical recipes that carry out the authenticity of Indian vegetarian cooking. For new cooks and cooks new to Indian vegetarian cooking, the combination of video tutorials and written recipes will make it easier for you to understand the fundamentals in cooking Indian dishes.

feeds.title: Rak's Kitchen
feeds.description: Find easy-to-learn recipes mainly Indian regional, eggless baking as well as some vegetarian-friendly global cuisine! All with step-by-step photos and quick videos that are beginner friendly. Learn how to make vegetarian recipes, south Indian, Tamil Nadu, North Indian, International & eggless baking recipes with step-by-step photos.

feeds.title: Spice Your Life Blog
feeds.description: The website, Spice Your Life Blog is a food and lifestyle blog created by Urvashi Pitre, a food writer, recipe developer, and photographer. The blog features recipes for Indian and fusion dishes, as well as articles on food, travel, and culture.

feeds.title: Belly Rules The Mind » Indian
feeds.description: The Belly Rules The Mind is a vegetarian and vegan food blog created by Anvita & Soniya. They share everyday healthy-ish recipes, some occasional treats, and even-you-can-do-this ideas. The recipes are all gluten-free, dairy-free, and refined sugar-free. Belly Rules The Mind's Indian section is a blog that features a variety of Indian recipes. The recipes are organized by categories, such as appetizers, main dishes, desserts, and drinks.

feeds.title: Vegetarian Times » Indian
feeds.description: The Vegetarian Times website has a tag for Indian cuisine, with recipes for dishes like shrikhand tart, paneer masala, dal makhani, samosas, chickpea and kale curry, dosa, and yellow lentil dal. Vegetarian Times is a magazine and website that focuses on food, culture, health, and lifestyle for vegetarians, vegans, and all people interested in plant-based eating.
